total_funding_usd.quote: StarSling has raised a $3 million pre-seed round from Bessemer Venture Partners, Y Combinator, and several other amazing investors

last_round.quote: A $3M pre-seed from Bessemer Venture Partners, Y Combinator and five more funds to make shipping code agent-native, and Review Runners in private beta.

note: Founded by Yonas Beshawred (CEO, previously founder/CEO of StackShare, which sold to FOSSA) and Daniel Worku (CTO). YC batch Spring 2025, Active, domain starsling.dev matches the provider's own site (card url starsling.dev/pricing) — hint confirmed, same company. Raised a $3M pre-seed (announced Sept 22, 2026) led by Bessemer Venture Partners with Y Combinator plus five more funds; no individual fund beyond Bessemer/YC named in available sources. StarSling Runners (CI product) launched publicly around April 2026; GPU Runners and Review Runners are newer/beta additions as of the pre-seed announcement.
